title: Robust Broad Learning System with Wave Loss for Classification under Data Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2608.29983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS) offers an efficient alternative to deep architectures by enabling fast learning through randomized feature mapping and closed-form solutions. However, its reliance on squared error loss makes it highly sensitive to noise, outliers, and corrupted labels, limiting its reliability in real-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Wave-BLS, a robust broad learning framework that integrates the wave loss function, which is asymmetric, bounded, and smooth, enabling controlled penalization of large errors. The proposed formulation replaces the standard least-squares objective with a wave-loss-based optimization problem, solved efficiently using a Nesterov accelerated gradient (NAG)-based scheme without requiring matrix inversion, thereby improving scalability. Extensive experiments on 30 UCI benchmark datasets demonstrate that Wave-BLS consistently outperforms classical BLS and several robust variants.

translated_title: 面向数据不确定性分类的基于波浪损失函数的鲁棒宽度学习系统
translated_abstract: 宽度学习系统通过随机特征映射和闭式解实现快速学习，为深度架构提供了一种高效的替代方案。然而，其对平方误差损失的依赖使其对噪声、异常值和损坏标签高度敏感，限制了其在真实场景中的可靠性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Wave-BLS，一个集成了波浪损失函数的鲁棒宽度学习框架，该损失函数具有非对称、有界且平滑的特性，能够对大误差进行可控惩罚。所提出的方法用基于波浪损失的优化问题替代了标准最小二乘目标，并采用基于Nesterov加速梯度的方案高效求解，无需矩阵求逆，从而提升了可扩展性。在30个UCI基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Wave-BLS持续优于经典BLS及多种鲁棒变体。
tldr: 提出Wave-BLS框架，通过引入非对称、有界且平滑的波浪损失函数并结合无需矩阵求逆的NAG加速梯度求解方案，显著提升了宽度学习系统在噪声、异常值和标签损坏等数据不确定性条件下的鲁棒性与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Wave-BLS, which integrates an asymmetric, bounded, and smooth wave loss function with a matrix-inversion-free NAG-based solver, significantly enhancing the robustness and scalability of Broad Learning Systems under data uncertainty such as noise, outliers, and corrupted labels.
